name: Dolibarr
description: Dolibarr is a modular open-source ERP and CRM platform for small businesses, associations, and freelancers, born in France. It covers invoicing, contacts, orders, inventory, HR, and accounting in a single self-hostable application with an active third-party module marketplace.

owner.name: Dolibarr Foundation
owner.description: French non-profit foundation governing the Dolibarr ERP/CRM open-source project.
